input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Sections 19.1-19.5 otherwise meet our position: professional and workmanlike Services by qualified personnel (19.1), material conformity of Services and Deliverables to documentation and specifications (19.1, 19.2), no malicious code and compliance with Applicable Law (19.3), a prompt re-perform/repair/replace remedy escalating to termination and refund of Fees paid that is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims (19.4), and a disclaimer that expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy (19.5), so the disclaimer does not swallow the express warranties. The only open gap is duration: Deliverables, which under Section 1.4 expressly include configurations and integrations and under Section 13.2 may embed software, carry a conformance window of only ninety days, whereas our preferred position is twelve (12) months for software-bearing deliverables (ninety days is our fallback). Hosted Services already conform throughout the subscription term, so the minimal fix is to extend the Deliverable window in 19.2 to twelve (12) months, stated with a numeral so the period is unambiguous, leaving the Hosted Services conformance, the authority warranty, the Section 19.4 remedy and the Section 19.5 carve-out untouched.

ops.oldText: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria.
ops.newText: For twelve (12) months after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Deliverable conformance warranty in Section 19.2 from ninety days to twelve (12) months, consistent with our position that delivered software and work product carry a twelve-month conformance warranty; the Section 19.4 repair, replacement and refund remedy is unchanged. If a twelve-month period is difficult, we can accept ninety (90) days for non-software Deliverables provided software-bearing Deliverables carry twelve (12) months.
proposal.summary: Extend Deliverable conformance warranty period from ninety days to twelve (12) months in Section 19.2.
